edges.reason: Constructor mints the total supply to msg.sender.
Constructor registers the AMM pair mapping entry.
Constructor creates and stores the uniswapV2Pair.
Constructor initializes maxTransactionAmount from totalSupply.
Constructor initializes swapTokensAtAmount.
Constructor initializes maxWallet.
Constructor sets marketingWallet to the owner address.
Constructor sets devWallet to the owner address.
Constructor calls excludeFromMaxTransaction for router, pair and owner.
Constructor calls excludeFromFees for owner, contract and dead address.
Constructor calls _setAutomatedMarketMakerPair directly.
Constructor mints supply through the ERC20 transfer/mint path.
_transfer keys the per-block delay on tx.origin, an attacker-influenced origin.
_latestTransfer is indexed by tx.origin when recording the block number.
_transfer stores block.timestamp in _latestSwapIn on buys.
_latestSwapIn holds a block.timestamp used for fee windows.
getSellFeesAccount compares block.timestamp against stored buy timestamps.
Sell fee window selection reads the _latestSwapIn mapping.
_transfer calls getSellFeesAccount for sells.
_transfer calls swapBack when the contract balance exceeds the threshold.
_transfer reads the blacklist mapping for the sender.
_transfer reads automatedMarketMakerPairs to classify buy/sell.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFees to decide takeFee.
_transfer reads _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount for limit checks.
_transfer accumulates tokensForLiquidity from collected fees.
_transfer accumulates tokensForMarketing from collected fees.
_transfer accumulates tokensForDev from collected fees.
_transfer toggles the swapping guard around swapBack.
swapBack calls _swapTokensForETH to convert tokens.
swapBack calls _addLiquidity after the swap.
swapBack reads and deletes tokensForLiquidity.
swapBack reads and deletes tokensForMarketing.
swapBack reads and deletes tokensForDev.
swapBack caps the swap amount using swapTokensAtAmount.
swapBack sends the remaining balance to marketingWallet.
swapBack sends ethForDev to devWallet.
_swapTokensForETH invokes the router swap with a timestamp deadline.
_swapTokensForETH approves and uses the uniswapV2Router.
_addLiquidity invokes router addLiquidityETH.
_addLiquidity approves and uses the uniswapV2Router.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidity deadline.
swapBack issues a low-level value call to devWallet.
swapBack issues a low-level value call to marketingWallet.
devWallet call can reenter swapBack while state/balance updates are still in progress.
marketingWallet call forwards the whole balance and can reenter swapBack.
amount multiplied by fee percentages and divided by sellTotalFees which may be zero.
Sell fee totals returned by getSellFeesAccount are used as divisors in _transfer.
swapBack divides contractBalance by tokensToSwap and by buyDivisorFees.

amount flows into limit checks, fee floor and super._transfer.
from drives blacklist, exclusion and AMM pair checks.
to drives maxWallet and automatedMarketMakerPairs checks.

contractTokenBalance determines the canSwap flag.
addr indexes _latestSwapIn when selecting the applied sell window.
tokenAmount is the amount passed to the router swap.
ethAmount is forwarded as msg.value to addLiquidityETH.

excludeFromFees writes _isExcludedFromFees.

disableTransferDelay clears txDelayEnabled.

updateMaxTransactionAmount writes maxTransactionAmount.
updateMaxWalletAmount writes maxWallet.
updateMarketingWallet writes marketingWallet.
updateSwapEnabled writes swapEnabled.
updateBuyTotalFees writes buyTotalFees.
updateBuyDivisorFees writes buyDivisorFees.
updateSellWindows writes sellWindow1.
updateLiquidityFeeForSellWindows writes sellLiquidityFeeWindow1.
updateMarketingFeeForSellWindows writes sellMarketingFeeWindow1.
isExcludedFromFees reads _isExcludedFromFees.
buyTotalFees is applied to the amount in buy fee calculation.
buyDivisorFees splits buy fees across the three buckets.
sellDevFee is added to the sell total in getSellFeesAccount.
sellWindow1 bounds the first timestamp comparison.
sellLiquidityFeeWindow1 is returned for the first window.
sellMarketingFeeWindow1 is returned for the first window.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter has no independent semantics outside _transfer; merge it into the function node to reduce parameter clutter.
The from parameter is only meaningful as part of _transfer's limit and fee logic.
The to parameter is only meaningful as part of _transfer's buy/sell classification.
The fees local is the direct result and input of the fee arithmetic block; merge into the unsafe operation node.
contractTokenBalance is a transient value used solely to trigger swapBack inside _transfer.
The addr parameter is only used to index _latestSwapIn within getSellFeesAccount.
tokenAmount is passed straight into the router swap call inside _swapTokensForETH.
ethAmount is forwarded as msg.value to addLiquidityETH inside _addLiquidity.
